verdict.rationale: Morph is an inference API and tooling platform. Such a product could plausibly let users attach external MCP servers as tools, so this axis applies. The evidence only documents Morph's own MCP server, which is the server role and lets other agents such as Claude Code use Morph's tools. Nothing shows Morph acting as an MCP client that consumes third-party MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
